confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on 2026 LA-specific guides and menu-price pages, but none is a systematic LA price survey, and the beer and cocktail figures are partly inferred from a national benchmark and a POS-vendor page. Cappuccino uses latte-range data. Restaurant meal anchors are rough per-person ranges from guides rather than venue checks. Accommodation anchors (all four hostel and hotel fields) are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings or booking pages were inspected, so they are the least certain values. FX: the 2026-10-16 value comes from the rba.gov.au exchange-rates page as surfaced in search, but I did not open the F11.1 data file; the RBA overview page showed 0.6955 at the 4pm fix on 2026-10-15, so the latest figure may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Los Angeles-specific or US-metro price data where available, with national US benchmarks as fallback. Beer draws on an LA menu-price page (domestic beer about USD 9) and a Toast metro note. Cocktail and wine are estimated from LA spirits and cocktail averages plus national cocktail and wine figures. Accommodation has no comparable-city basis beyond general knowledge of Los Angeles summer lodging levels in peak season.
